title: kohleria rubricaulis

It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including its reported health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Kohleria rubricaulis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. However, limited information is available about the bioactive constituents of Kohleria rubricaulis, but it is likely to contain compounds such as iridoids and phenolic acids.
